title: S'Mores Bars
description: This s'mores bars recipe contains the flavors of beloved s'mores in a cereal bar, including graham crackers, melted chocolate, and gooey marshmallows.
ingredients: 18 whole graham crackers, crumbled into small pieces
0.5 teaspoon Spice Islands® Pure Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheated the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan; set aside.
Combine crackers and rice cereal in a large bowl; set aside.

Heat corn syrup and sugar together in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until begins to boil around edges, 4 to 5 minutes. Alternatively, combine corn syrup and sugar in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave on high until begins to boil, about 2 minutes. Stir in butter, baking soda, and vanilla.
Pour syrup over cereal mixture; stir to coat. Transfer mixture to the prepared pan; press firmly to even top. Place chocolate bars in a single layer over cereal mixture; sprinkle with marshmallows.
Bake in the preheated oven until marshmallows are puffed and lightly brown, 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from oven; top with mini chocolate chips.
Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. Cut into squares. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
